quote: GitLab Secrets Manager is now generally available on GitLab.com and GitLab Self-Managed.
stop_saying: GitLab Secrets Manager is in Limited Availability on GitLab.com (or in open beta and not ready for production).
say_instead: GitLab Secrets Manager is generally available on GitLab.com and GitLab Self-Managed (GitLab 19.5), built on OpenBao, and consumes GitLab Credits.
old_quote: GitLab Secrets Manager, now in Limited Availability on GitLab.com, makes credentials more secure and keeps them in the same platform that runs your pipelines.

quote: GitLab Orbit is generally available on GitLab.com.
stop_saying: GitLab Orbit and the Knowledge Graph are in beta.
say_instead: GitLab Orbit is generally available on GitLab.com (GitLab 19.5) for Premium and Ultimate; a 30-day trial is available through the account team.
old_quote: Orbit and the Knowledge Graph are in Beta.

quote: In previous versions of GitLab, MCP clients could reach only a limited set of GitLab tools. Now the GitLab MCP server is generally available.
stop_saying: The GitLab MCP server exposes only a limited set of GitLab tools.
say_instead: The GitLab MCP server is generally available on all tiers (GitLab 19.5), with toolset selection and new rate limits.

quote: GitLab 19.3, is now generally available and is the default layout.
stop_saying: The redesigned Agentic Chat UI in VS Code and JetBrains is a beta you have to turn on.
say_instead: The new Agentic Chat UI is generally available and the default layout in VS Code and JetBrains (GitLab 19.5); no beta setting is needed.
old_quote: JetBrains IDEs has a redesigned UI, now available as a beta.

quote: Non-default branch tracking is now generally available.
stop_saying: Tracking vulnerabilities on non-default branches is a beta feature.
say_instead: Non-default branch vulnerability tracking is generally available in Ultimate (GitLab 19.5).

quote: In previous versions of GitLab, Observability was an experiment. Now it’s in beta on GitLab.com and GitLab Self-Managed.
say_instead: GitLab Observability (OpenTelemetry traces, metrics and logs) is in beta on GitLab.com and Self-Managed and free during the beta; do not sell it as GA.

quote: Rapid Diffs, a ground-up rewrite of how GitLab renders diffs, is now generally available
stop_saying: Rapid Diffs is a beta you can switch back from; the classic diff view is the default.
say_instead: Rapid Diffs is listed as generally available and replacing the classic diff view in the upcoming GitLab 19.6; confirm on release day before committing to it.
old_quote: Rapid Diffs is in beta. Some features from the classic diff experience aren’t yet available.

quote: Workspace subagents, previously released as an experiment, are now generally available.
say_instead: Workspace subagents are listed as generally available in the upcoming GitLab 19.6.
